AutoSculpt Studio

From dream to reality

The workshop of 3D models for AutoSculpt 3D: from a description (typed, dictated or sent from the phone) or from photos to a 3D model you can look at from every side, then send to AutoSculpt 3D to turn into a sheet-metal sculpture.

The app is installed in the Applications folder. If AutoSculpt 3D already downloaded the engine that makes 3D models on this computer, Studio takes it over without downloading it again.
